title: Bread and wine

explicit_facts.text: Jesus breaks and blesses bread, gives it to the disciples, and directs them to distribute it to the multitude.

title: The bread and wine teaching
summary: A speaker addresses others, teaching about eating the bread, drinking the wine, and the soul being filled.

explicit_facts.text: He speaks to a group of listeners.
He teaches that one who eats the bread and drinks the wine receives nourishment for the soul, which shall never hunger or thirst but shall be filled.

The multitude both sees and hears Jesus.
Jesus says he is finishing the commandment the Father gave concerning this people, a remnant of the house of Israel.
